license_expression: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
unsafe_policy: workspace forbid retained; safe wrapper API used

semantics.linux: component resolution openat2 BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS|NO_XDEV; no insecure fallback on ENOSYS/EAGAIN/errors
semantics.macos: single-component openat NOFOLLOW with DIRECTORY on ancestors; anchored enumeration Dir::read_from; cross-device refusal
semantics.mount_limit: macOS device check does not detect same-device mount attachment; Linux NO_XDEV rejects mount traversal
semantics.root: canonical explicit root admission followed by NOFOLLOW absolute handle walk; root/physical lineage retained and revalidated
semantics.inventory: directory handles enumerate, initial/end/final identity+stamp observations cover root/empty directories; changes mark partial coverage
